day_titles.3: Punakha dzong and the new year party

1: Arrival at Bagdogra and transfer to Phuentsholing
Border formalities at the Bhutan Gate
Check in and the rest of the day free
2: Breakfast, then north into the hills towards Thimphu
The Chukha dam and the Wang Chhu gorge on the way
The Bengal plains laid out flat below
3: Breakfast, then out into the capital
Punakha Dzong between the Pho and Mo rivers
The long suspension bridge over the water
A New Year dinner laid on for the group
Bhutanese dances and archery in the courtyard
4: Breakfast, then west down the valley to Paro
Terraced fields and farmhouses the whole way
The Memorial Chorten and the Buddha Dordenma
Tashichho Dzong and the takin preserve
5: Breakfast, then out into the Paro valley
The climb up the pine slope to Taktsang
The monastery wedged into the cliff face
6: Breakfast, then the long run back south
Down through the Chukha gorge to the plains
Optional: Zangto Pelri Lhakhang in the town
Arrival transfer and check in for the night
7: Breakfast at the hotel and check out
Border formalities and transfer to Siliguri

expert.name: Tenzin
expert.quote: Built around the New Year, with the celebration laid on for the group and the Chele La pass on the way home.
expert.tip: Book this one by September. Bhutan has a hotel cap over New Year and the Thimphu rooms are gone first.

summary: 7 days through Phuentsholing, Thimphu, Paro, with 6 nights, Breakfast and dinner each day and a licensed Bhutanese guide: the kharbandi gompa, the punakha sightseeing tour, the new year celebration, the thimphu sightseeing tour.
included: Included: 6 nights across Phuentsholing, Thimphu, Paro with Breakfast and dinner each day; all land transfers by private vehicle; the Kharbandi Gompa; the Punakha sightseeing tour; the New Year celebration; the Thimphu sightseeing tour; the Hike to the Tiger's Nest; a licensed Bhutanese guide; permits and the sustainable development fee as quoted.
not_included: Not included: international and domestic flights; lunches and any meals not listed; monument entrance fees where not stated; travel insurance; personal expenses.
